description: 洪水浸水想定区域図 [flood] (series on BODIK ODCS) is a series of datasets listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by BODIK (Open Data Catalogue Service of Japanese local governments). 近年、大雨や短時間強雨の発生頻度が増加し、全国各地で毎年のように甚大な洪水被害が発生しています。 このような中、和歌山県では洪水浸水想定区域図を作成・公表しています。 なお、洪水浸水想定区域図は、対象河川の洪水に伴う氾濫を想定していますが、平成23年の紀伊半島大水害で発生したような土石流や流木に起因する河道閉塞による氾濫はその不確実性が高... Coverage: Japan. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The datasets are filed under 3 publishers. Its tags are マップ, 地図, 洪水, 浸水, 災害. It offers 89 resource(s) in pdf, zip. The portal shows 2024-03-29 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
